{{ProductPage|http://www.ubnt.com/sr2}} :[http://dl.ubnt.com/sr2_datasheet.pdf Datasheet] There could possibly be multiple major revisions of this device in the wild - the FCC ID EUT is an AR5212 card w/ 2 U.FL connectors while most others seem to be as depicted on the '''UBNT''' site. .. or the FCC EUT is simply an early pre-release device and does not reflect on released models. ==Additional specifications== The following specs are per '''UBNT''''s datasheet for the device. {{802dot11 RxSens|11b |1M=-97 |2M=-96 |5.5M=-95 |11M=-92 }} {{802dot11 RxSens|11g |6M=-94 |9M=-93 |12M=-91 |18M=-90 |24M=-86 |36M=-83 |48M=-77 |54M=-74 }} :The Rx Sens specifications for all the XR/SR 2/5 series seem to be identical..
